category_edits.rationale: Reduce Transformer depth from three blocks to two across all four datasets to test whether fewer blocks reduce overfitting and repeated information loss at the existing dropout rate. Existing metadata saves NUM_BLOCKS, and the predictor reconstructs that depth automatically. Preserve all other model and training settings.

change_summary: Change the bound SASRec depth to two blocks, retaining one independently trained model per category and metadata-driven prediction.
